svg.title: 3C context map: what each context file holds and which step reads it
svg.desc: CLAUDE.md is read in every session and carries the rules marked load inject, which 3c rules apply refuses to write at 150 or more directives. Rule packs in .claude/rules are loaded by Claude Code itself and consulted by /3c-implement, /3c-test and /3c-review. The /3c-review checklist is read only by /3c-review. .3c/architecture.yaml is read by the post-edit boundary check, 3c-architect and 3c arch-check. .3c/hooks.yaml is read by the commit gate and 3c hook confirm. .3c/test-map.json is read only by 3c test select in the inner loop.
